question: top-1 vs top-2 pool pick per box, with the SAM caches present

heldout_train.population: records_grefcoco_train_tune.jsonl (loadable rows, SAM caches built by exp137)

decision: switch the shipped pick to top-1 (change 16); the decision rule was fixed before the full-val pass and rests on the held-out train frame; the val-2000 curve was measured earlier as part of the descriptive sensitivity artifact and is disclosed here as an agreeing cross-check (it was NOT used to fit anything)
disclosure: the val-2000 sensitivity curve was observed before this decision; the selection itself was made on the held-out train frame only

effects.appliesto: all targeted records, both terms and boxes

selection_history_precision.study_that_chose_top2: exp117 joint study (optuna_study_gref14.json) DID search topk (suggest_int 1..2) and chose top-2 under its own objective: the val-prevalence-weighted mixture of the mean targeted IoU m (study mix 0.6803 vs shipped-equivalent 0.6380) - an m-based objective, not cIoU or gIoU
selection_history_precision.why_this_is_a_new_selection: the shipped headline metric is cIoU; under cIoU and gIoU (raw and val-prevalence-weighted) on the SAME held-out train rows with SAM present, top-1 leads top-2 on all four: raw cIoU 51.13/49.81, raw gIoU 70.13/68.93, val-prev cIoU 49.89/48.64, val-prev gIoU 79.25/78.52. The re-selection aligns the knob with the reported metric on train-side data
selection_history_precision.earlier_no_sam_note: the first re-analysis of this wall (2026-10-08/09 sensitivity work) ran on this population WITHOUT any SAM caches, so the topk contrast there (top-2 ahead) reflected a configuration that is not the deployed one; the caches built by exp137 restore the studies' regime
selection_history_precision.val_side_disclosure: the val-2000 descriptive sensitivity curve (measured earlier) agrees (+1.19 cIoU for top-1); it was NOT used to fit anything and the selection was made on the held-out train frame only
